errors.evidence: "FINAL ANSWER: Brunei, China, Kuwait, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Korea"
errors.description: The assistant fabricated the inclusion of China in the list of countries whose gross savings consistently exceeded 35% of GDP from 2001 to 2010. According to World Bank data, China’s gross savings as a percentage of GDP during that period did not consistently surpass 35%; it was generally around 30%. The assistant did not verify this fact with the World Bank dataset or any reliable source, leading to a hallucinated answer.
